about: Figures behind the page on Japan's Worker Burden Relief Payment (就業者負担軽減支援金), /guides/worker-relief-payment/. Each fact gives its value, the date it refers to, its status (decided: in the bill or government documents; considering: the government said in the Diet that it is considering it; reported: a plan reported by the press; open: not decided), the source and the day it was checked. build.js checks that every language of the page carries the digits listed under 'digits' (any one of the alternatives in each nested list), and the page's household calculator takes its amounts and rates from 'calc' (fact ids) and 'comparison'.
